title: Finite balanced comparison formula
statement:
theorem finite_formula_exists
    (b : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ leftComplex l E L ι g ≅
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ rightComplex l E L ι g)
    (hb : CompletedFormula l E L ι g b) :
    ∃ bfin : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ finiteLeft l E L ι g n ≅
          (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ finiteRight l E L ι g n,
      FiniteFormula l E L ι g bfin

proof.text: Apply the unit-case finite comparison theorem to the supplied completed comparison, obtaining a finite comparison whose formula has middle coefficient equal to one.
Use scalar linearity and the balancing relation to extend the unit formula to arbitrary middle finite coefficients.
